Subject: Parallax roadmap shift — postpone inference demo + next steps

Hi Rishi / Laura —

Quick update from our side: leadership just reprioritized Q1 roadmaps across the platform org to focus on a core performance sprint and an acquisition integration. That means the inference demo we had penciled for next week needs to be postponed — likely until Q4 unless the roadmap changes.

There are two practical constraints driving this: 1) our ML team is on site for a migration the week of the original demo, and 2) the execs want us to freeze new pilots until the acquisition completes.

Can we do two things:
- Put the upcoming demo on hold for now and remove the calendar holds linked to the original invite.
- Send a short mutual action plan or one-pager with suggested check-in cadence so we can restart quickly if priorities flip back.

Appreciate the flexibility here — Miles

Miles Turner
Director, Data Platforms
Parallax Systems

Thanks for the heads up, Miles — totally understand the need to reallocate during an acquisition window.

We can absolutely pause the demo and take the calendar holds down. I'll attach a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that outlines a few restart triggers, suggested check-in cadence (monthly/quarterly), and the minimal engineering touchpoints so the discovery doesn't go cold.

If helpful, we can also offer a single 30-minute "office hours" slot each month (virtual) where your team can drop in with questions without committing to a full pilot. No cost, no heavy prep — keeps the relationship warm.

Next steps from our side:
- I will remove the existing demo invites today.
- Attaching MAP + a draft SOW for planning purposes.
- Marissa / Laura: can you both flag any redlines we should be prepared for when we re-engage?

Cheers,

—

Thanks, Rishi — appreciate the quick response and the MAP.

Two quick notes:
1) The acquisition timeline is currently expected to run through late Q2, and the exec ask is to deprioritize new pilots until both the integration plan and our budget reconciliation finish. So Q4 is our best guess for a restart window but that could move.
2) The ML lead asked that sensitive onboarding items (data contracts, KMS details) not be discussed until the integration team gives the green light.

For now please:
- Remove the demo holds (confirmed).
- Keep the MAP and SOW on file; we will ask for them when we start to plan again.
- If you can, can you add a single line in the MAP documenting the restart trigger we should watch for (e.g., acquisition signed, budget re-opened)? That will make it easier to triage internally.

I"m copying our internal scheduling policy into this thread so you have context: we are minimizing vendor onboarding during acquisition activities.
